summary: BUG NOT CONFIRMED: Text IS displaying correctly on book pages. Desktop testing (1920x1080) verified that all 10 pages of 'The Wizard's Apprentice' show text_content on the right side of the two-page spread. TextPage component at RealisticPageFlip.jsx lines 370-433 is working correctly. Mobile tests showed 'Sign In Required' due to authentication session issues during viewport resize, NOT a text rendering bug.
action_items: NO BUG FOUND - Text is displaying correctly on all book pages
User-reported issue may be device-specific or cache-related
Recommend asking user for: specific device, browser, and whether they tried hard refresh (Ctrl+F5)
critical_code_review_comments: TextPage component correctly checks page?.text_content and renders it
Mobile portrait view (BookReader.js line 1166) also correctly checks currentPageData?.text_content
Book API returns 10 pages with text_content from 700-800+ characters each
context_for_next_testing_agent: Text rendering is WORKING. If user still reports issue, it may be: 1) Browser cache issue - suggest hard refresh, 2) Device-specific issue - need exact device/browser info, 3) Network issue causing API response truncation
